Good to know

Frequently asked questions

How do I book an appointment?

Use the request form on this page, tap the chat button, or call us at (303) 726-1492. Let us know your dog's breed and what they need and we'll get you set.

Do you groom all breeds and sizes?

Yes — from tiny pups to big fluffy guys. We tailor the groom to your dog's coat and temperament.

My dog gets anxious. Can you help?

Absolutely. We go slow, stay calm, and make first visits gentle and positive. Just let us know when you book so we can plan extra time.

How long does a full groom take?

Usually 2 to 4 hours depending on size and coat. We'll give you a pickup window when you drop off.
